READ_INDEX.semantics: Current read cursor position in the ring buffer, incremented by the processor after audio samples are successfully copied to the output channels.

WRITE_INDEX.semantics: Current write cursor position in the ring buffer, incremented by the worker after new PCM data is fetched and decoded.

FRAMES_AVAILABLE_INDEX.semantics: Count of decoded frames ready in the ring buffer. Processor decrements atomically on consume; worker increments atomically on write. Clamped at zero to avoid race conditions.

END_OF_STREAM_INDEX.semantics: Set to 1 by the worker to signal the processor that no further PCM data will be supplied for the current track.

STOP_INDEX.semantics: Set to 1 by the worker to suspend processing and instruct the processor to emit silence immediately without checking available frames or signalling underruns.

TOTAL_FRAMES_RENDERED_INDEX.semantics: Monotonically increasing count of total frames processed and rendered by the processor.

HEARTBEAT_COUNT_INDEX.semantics: Heartbeat count incremented by the processor at the end of each process block to serve as a liveness indicator.

REFILL_REQUEST_INDEX.semantics: Futex target for waitAsync. Incremented by the processor when available frames drop below the low-water mark, waking the worker's refill loop.

TARGET_FRAMES_INDEX.semantics: Target number of frames the worker aims to keep filled in the ring buffer for adaptive buffering.

UNDERRUN_EPISODES_INDEX.semantics: Atomically incremented by the processor whenever a render quantum is processed with zero frames available while not at end-of-stream.

SILENT_FRAMES_INDEX.semantics: Atomically accumulated count of silent frames output by the processor during underrun episodes.

EPOCH_INDEX.semantics: Transaction epoch counter. Incremented by the worker during seeks or resets. Processor aborts index commits if the epoch changes mid-process loop.
